remarks: Welcome to an exceptional opportunity in the highly desirable West Norwalk neighborhood, perfectly positioned near Oak Hills Park Golf Course, minutes to the Merritt Parkway, and offering easy access to South Wilton, New Canaan, and Norwalk's beautiful beaches. This beautifully maintained ranch combines comfort, style, and an open-concept layout designed for modern living. The spacious living room, highlighted by a charming wood-burning stove, flows seamlessly into the dining area-ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Just off the kitchen and dining room is a sun-filled three-season porch, providing an inviting extension of the living space and overlooking the peaceful, private, fenced backyard. It's the perfect spot for morning coffee, relaxing with a book, or hosting guests. Hardwood floors run through most of the main level. The primary suite features a well-appointed en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet, while the two additional bedrooms offer generous space for family, guests, or a home office. The lower level adds exceptional versatility with a partially finished area suitable for a playroom, gym, or media room, complemented by ample unfinished space for storage or future expansion. With its unbeatable location, inviting layout, and exceptional lifestyle amenities-from top-rated golf to shoreline recreation-this West Norwalk gem offers outstanding value and should not be missed.
